story.heading: Rebuilding Standards for a Disordered Industry
paragraphs: RedBridge Consulting was founded out of frustration with an industry that had lost its standards. Fake job listings, hidden fees, unqualified advisers — these weren't isolated incidents. They were the norm. In 2024, we formally incorporated as RedBridge Consulting Pty Ltd.

From day one, we committed to a single principle: everything we tell you should be verifiable. We share employer names, industry, and sponsorship approval status during your free consultation — before you pay a single dollar. Fees are structured in milestones, so you only pay when we deliver.

Our legal work is handled exclusively by Insight Idea, a registered Australian law firm and MARA-licensed migration agency. That separation of responsibilities — career matching on our side, legal compliance on theirs — is what makes our service both thorough and trustworthy.
